profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience, working on Design, Development and Maintenance of Java/J2EE based suite of applications, BPM and ESB technologies for leading companies based in USA and Mexico.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
I have been collaborating on multiple projects for clients like Capital One, Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

Responsibilities:

T-shaped agile team member participating on all stages of the development cycle (Planning, Requirements, Design, Build, Document, Test, Deploy, Maintain)
Automating production deployments with validations on lower environments via one single click pipeline.
Designing and executing perf tests, ensuring the SLAs and all the Nonfunctional requirements are fulfilled (Stress, Endurance, Load, Burst)
Automating most of the functional tests via Karate/Cucumber frameworks and running test suit on a cadence or every time a new change is committed and deployed.
Automating deployments via Jenkins pipeline and terraform files to manage the infrastructure on the cloud.
Designing and Implementing new REST API to generate and deliver OneTimePin messages to the client.
Providing full support to production stacks since are critical applications, considering the team owns the infrastructure which is on AWS.
Spread the knowledge across team members, technical or business knowledge and generate proper documentation.
Creation of multiple dashboards to monitor production stacks via Splunk, oneRelic, DataDog, CloudWatch, etc.
Implementing Business rules and traffic routing policies to interact with multiple components.
Perform code reviews providing valuable feedback
Leading and supporting production releases, following blue/green strategy and traffic switching.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
OneTimePin APIs provide the capability to the end user to authenticate and login to their bank accounts providing a One Time Pin via SMS, Email or Phone Call as a second factor authentication making more secure and robust all digital services provided by Capital one.

Responsibilities:
- T-shaped agile team member participating on all stages of the development cycle (Planning, Requirements, Design, Build, Document, Test, Deploy, Maintain).
- Automating production deployments with validations on lower environments via one single click pipeline.
- Designing and executing perf tests, ensuring the SLAs and all the Nonfunctional requirements are fulfilled (Stress, Endurance, Load, Burst)
- Automating most of the functional tests via Karate/Cucumber frameworks and running test suit on a cadence or every time a new change is committed and deployed.
- Automating deployments via jenkins pipeline and terraform files to manage the infrastructure on the cloud.
- Designing and Implementing new REST API to generate and deliver OneTimePin messages to the client.
Providing full support to production stacks since are critical applications, considering the team owns the infrastructure which is on AWS.
- Spread the knowledge across team members, technical or business knowledge and generate proper documentation.
- Creation of multiple dashboards to monitor production stacks via Splunk, oneRelic, DataDog, CloudWatch, etc.
- Implementing Business rules and traffic routing policies to interact with multiple components.
- Perform code reviews providing valuable feedback
- Leading and supporting production releases, following blue/green strategy and traffic switching.

Environment: Java, Private Key Infrastructure, Camel, Business Rule Engine, Shell Scripting, Docker, JavaScript, Angular, Python, SQL, Html, REST, JAX-WS, Junit, Cucumber, Karate, Sonar, Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, GIT, Linux, AWS, Microservices, Oracle, Redis Cache, JMeter, PagerDuty, Splunk, Snowflake, New Relic.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
Servicing Marketplace is an application within Fannie Mae which provides the capability to the servicer to start the communication to multiple sellers which potentially will sell a set of loans in a fashioned and smooth way. This app increases the loans volume purchased via Fannie Mae and making easier the communication between the seller and server making more robust Fannie's position in the secondary mortgage market.

Responsibilities:
- As a fully agile/scrum T-shaped team, I participate discovering/grooming the business requirement
- Implementation of UI modules written on Angular integrated with RestFul Backend services.
- Implementation of REST APIs and proper swagger documentation.
- Run performance testing as part of the user story scope, analyze and provide recommendations.
- Implement automated testing via BDD approach automated triggered via Jenkins.
- Provide production support alternating responsibilities with another scrum team.
- Train Jr team members on technologies or tools.
- Perform code reviews providing valuable feedback to the author
- Direct interaction with final users receiving valuable feedback

Environment:
Core Java, Angular, Shell Scripting, Autosys, JavaScript, JDBC, Html, Web Services, JAX-WS, JPA, Junit, Cucumber, Selenium, Sonar, Jenkins, Nexus, Maven, GIT, Linux, AWS, Microservices API, Oracle, Gemfire, JMeter.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
The CCTS application is one of Freddie Mac core applications where the organizations can be managed, and risk level is calculated based on business rules to identify before starting any transaction with a given entity. This application has suffered major changes year to year where the lack of unitary tests have represented a challenge while performing changes to the application and identifying bugs. In order to decrease this risk a test framework was designed and implemented, also the analysis to achieve the DB normalization was performed to decrease redundant data and design an effective DB.

Responsibilities:
- Full analysis and complete understanding of the current solution based in Java/Prime Faces/JPA/SQL Server.
- Analysis of Stored procedures, DB triggers, java code, shell scripts and interaction to downstream/upstream applications in order to identify dependencies, level of coupling and impact analysis.
- Solution design to normalize the multiple SQL server instances into a single instance, identifying all the impacted components and merging tables avoiding duplicates structures.

Environment:
Core Java, Prime Faces, J2EE, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Triggers, Shell Scripting, Autosys Jobs, JavaScript, Servlets, WebLogic, Web Services, JAX-WS, AJAX, Eclipse, SoapUI, JPA, Junit, Mockito, Sonar, Jenkins, Artifactory, Ant, Maven, GIT, Linux.

positions.title: Senior Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Analysis, design, development and test the employer portal enhancements for current medical enrollment system for group members. Enhancements were made to user interface, workflow, back end services and business rule engine to improve the performance and moere fluent transactions, avoiding unnecessary validations and identifying flows that can be executed asynchronously or in parallel in order to improve the response time of the application and the user experience. The current solution was implemented as web application supported by backend services based in several technologies like Java, JSP, Facets, CWS, Struts, Web Services and REST Services.

•	Understand the functional and non-functional requirements through grooming sessions in order to analyze the changes and impacts in the current systems and give properly estimations.
•	Full analyze and complete understanding of the current solution based in Java/Facets/CWS/ESB technologies.
•	Configuration local environment like database, application server, debugging tools, repositories, Jenkins, to be able to deploy the application in the workstation.
•	Following the TDD strategy to generate the unit tests with Junit and Mockito library.
•	Development of use cases, modifying/creating user interfaces, services, workflows, changes in data bases and configuring the tools.
•	Design user interfaces using JSP, Java Script, CSS and HTML.
•	Integrate the back end services through ESB Broker services and queue messages to access the legacy systems.
•	Sharing the technical design and the gained knowledge to the offshore team members.

Environment:

FACETS, CWS, Core Java, J2EE, Oracle, SQL server JSP,  JavaScript, Html, Servlets, SQL, WAS, Web Services, JAX-WS, CXF, Rest Services, JSON, AJAX, Eclipse, SoapUI, Struts , Spring, Hibernate, Junit, Sonar, Jenkins, Nexus,  Maven, Subversion, Unix.

positions.title: Jr Solution Architect
positions.description:
Acting as the bridge between the enterprise context and the application-specific requirements such that the solution meets the project requirements and conforms to the enterprise architecture. Generating guidelines with the best practices of the technologies to the development team and building some artifacts with high reuse across the enterprise using scrum as agile methodology.

•	Member of the architecture committee, presenting solutions and helping several teams with their solutions designs and developing components.
•	Development of java applications with high level of complexity using spring core framework, generating unit tests and building the artifact with maven.
•	Development of SOAP Web services aligned to the WS standards like security and transaction.
•	Design and development web application user interface using MVC front end pattern with AngularJS framework, creating directives and filters. Integrating angular with bootstrap in order to create a responsive interface that will be displayed in mobile devices.
•	Defining guidelines with the best practices and design patterns to be used.
•	Making a PoC (Proof of concept) of new tools, technologies, frameworks and design patterns.
•	Documenting the architecture of the enterprise application with UML and TOGAF views.
•	SWAT member team, giving solution to production issues with high level of complexity in any layer like java application, BPM, ESB, ILOG, Exstream, Documentum, and DB2.

Environment:
Core Java, J2EE, DB2, LDAP, JQuery, JSP, Javascript, Angular, Html, SQL, BPM IBM, ESB Broker IBM, Bpel, ESQL, Documentum, Exstream, Informatica, WAS, Tivoli Access Manager, IBM MQ Web Services, JAX-WS, CXF, Rest Services, WS-Security, AJAX, RAD , Eclipse, SoapUI, Rational Performance Tester, SSO, LTPA tokens, Spring, Spring Security ,Hibernate, Multithreading, Junit, Sonar, Hudson, Artifactory, Maven, RTC.

positions.title: Software IT Architect
positions.description:
Enhance Java based Web Application, developing the module of electronic billing and solving issues with high priority and high level of complexity. As a member of the architecture team we were responsible of the development environment and the apps deployed in the infrastructure.

•	Solving critical issues in java coding and tool configurations like Hudson, WebLogic, BPM and OSB.
•	Code review of each development to be deployed on the infrastructure and verify if is aligned to the guidelines stipulated by de architecture team
•	Configuring shared Libraries and JNDIs in WebLogic and creating automatic deployments with integration tools like Hudson.
•	Defining guidelines to the development team with the best practices and design patterns to be used.
•	Develop electronic billing module based in Java/BPM/ESB technologies.
•	Apply QA tests to the developments with tools like Sonar and code review.
•	Configure WebLogic application server to establish a secure channel over SSL between applications.


Environment:
Core Java, J2EE, Oracle DB, LDAP, JSP, Javascript, Html, SQL, Oracle BPM, Oracle Service Bus, Bpel, JDeveloper, Weblogic, Web Services, JAX-RPC, Axis2, Rest Services, WS-Security, AJAX, Eclipse, SoapUI, SSO, Spring, Spring Security ,Hibernate, Junit, Sonar, Hudson, Nexus, Maven, SVN.

positions.title: Senior Engineer Software
positions.description:
Maintenance of critical artifacts for generating authentication and authorization to several application, defining protocols and secure standards of cipher to handle all the sensible information. Also the analysis, design and development of a web application in charge of calculating the level of risk for certain accounts to money laundering.

•	Generate secure models using PKI and SAML standard to secure the internal applications.
•	Webseal configuration to create junctions.
•	Configure the single sign on between application servers through LTPA tokens.
•	Sessions with Latin-American team to teach how must be configured the artifacts.
•	Development of shell scripts for control and administrative purposes. 
•	Generation of unitary test, stress test and integration test. 
•	Generation and maintenance of java key stores through shell scripting.
•	Developing a java web based application using Spring MVS, Spring Core, Spring security and Spring AOP programing.
•	Secure Web services using the ws-security standard.
•	Generation of stored procedures PL/SQL to retrieve and update information from Oracle DB.


Environment:
Core Java, J2EE, Oracle DB, LDAP, JQuery, JSP, Javascript, Html, SQL, WAS, Tivoli Access Manager, Web Services, JAX-WS, CXF, Rest Services, WS-Security, AJAX, RAD , Eclipse, SoapUI, SSO, OTP, LTPA tokens, Spring, Spring Security ,Hibernate, Junit, Sonar, Maven, JavaKeystores, PKI model, saml, Oauth, Struts, EJB.
